A.name: Ground truth provenance
A.details: Source uses dataset groundtruth.txt for evaluation and training targets; no model-generated reference was found. Dataset/GT bytes, cases, and deployed dependency chain were not supplied, so actual raw provenance and independent protocol conformance remain unverified. The evaluator is a hash-locked local implementation using VOT overlap primitives.

B.name: Score normalization
B.details: Metrics use per-sequence selected-overlap means and visible-GT counts, macro-average the curves, then select their maximum harmonic F. Confidence values determine threshold ranks; P/R/F are not divided by the model score maximum. Raw [0,1] and percent values agree, as do reported P/R/F harmonic identities.

C.name: Result existence/status/numeric agreement
C.details: Six captured E1-E3 metric texts exist and their original UTF-8 SHA values match history. E3 metrics, stage exits, training final ID, ledger and CSV agree. Original CRLF copies were distinguished from the new 18/18 exact LF materialization. Prediction receipt/plan/bundle/checkpoint bytes and analyzer process receipts remain absent, so the declared bindings cannot be closed independently.

D.name: Metric call reachability / dead code
D.details: The suite explicitly invokes ope_analyze; the dispatched function calls evaluate_depthtrack_results and writes its output. _load_rows, _vot_overlaps and _determine_thresholds have actual callers in that function. No orphaned claimed metric computation was found. This is source-call and captured-output validation, not an independent attestation of the missing analyzer process or its live imported bytes. VOT is a later conditional stage and has no captured result.

E.name: Coverage, seeds, and protocol claims
E.details: One seed (2027), three captured paired OPE epochs. E3 declares 50/76373 and 80/101956; counts agree with source and bbox-count observations, but individual prediction/GT files are absent. Test50 and CDTB80 select the checkpoint; the bank uses human multiframe aids; inherited 37-sequence E1 prefix and non-exact legacy RNG are disclosed. E4 launch exists but no complete E4 sequence or metric is captured. No M124 VOT/all-nine completion or semantic-causality claim is supported.

F.name: Evaluation type
F.details: Both OPEs are real_gt by inspected dataflow: predictions are compared with dataset annotation files. Their metrics are captured results rather than fresh re-evaluations in this audit. Human-confirmed text is an input protocol, not human scoring; current-frame GT IoU is the C training target, not synthetic evaluation GT or future memory-utility validation. No M124 VOT result is classified as completed.
